citations.claim: light body crossed thin wall between steps 281-282 and ended far beyond it at first violating step
body was moving at ~568 m/s at violating step, ~19 units per dt so substeps missed wall
one step before violation body was just left of wall

explanation: Heavy (m=20, vx=59) body strikes light (m=0.2) body, slingshotting it to ~568 m/s. At dt=1/30 the per-step displacement (~19 units) vastly exceeds 0.1 wall thickness; substep splitting (68 substeps => ~0.28 units per substep still >0.1 thickness) fails to prevent centre crossing through wall 0 between 281 and 282, violating no_tunneling while energy stays conserved.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 281 and 282

vision_note: A heavy blue body and a small red body approach a thin vertical wall from the left across steps 279 to 281. At step 282 the blue body stays left of the wall while the red body instantly reappears far to the right of the wall, having tunneled straight through it.
